activity_summary: You said the four words several ways. You tried them lower, and as a man who had been waiting, and neither humble nor brisk. You kept the King's address in his mouth and the answer in yours. You meant to play the old man.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the line until the mouth was the one he will play.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Four words, several ways

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Ould Iohn of Gaunt time honoured Lancaster.
